---
title: "Placebo fits"
params:
  covariates: false
  models: null
  scenarios: [1, 2, 3]
  nrep: 200
  nboot: 200
  mc_cores: 18
  overwrite: false
  out_root: "data/simulation/placebo"
---

## Purpose

Fit every model the paper reports under the 200 saved placebo schedules of each assignment mechanism, without covariates (default) or with the four county covariates (`-P covariates:true`). Each fit sees only the untreated outcomes of its schedule (`fit_blind()`); the saved rows are the years before each county's actual adoption, so every placebo prediction can be checked against an observed untreated outcome. One file per model and scenario, `<out_root>/<wocov|wcov>/<model>_<scenario>.rds`, with the point prediction `y0_hat` and 200 draws `y0_post_*` of the untreated mean.

| Model | Used in | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `twfe` | main | county and year fixed effects (fixest, Bayesian bootstrap) |
| `etwfe` | main | cohort × group cell and year fixed effects |
| `rw`, `rwi`, `rwst` | main | nested INLA models on the cells: deviation walks per adopting cell; RW-IID adds iid county effects, RW-ST a BYM2 × AR(1) field; default priors |
| `xgb` | main | GB-Ens, boosted departures from a cell ETWFE baseline |
| `twfe_v`, `etwfe_v` | S5 (covariates only) | TWFE with covariate slopes varying linearly in time; ETWFE with cohort- and year-varying slopes (cohorts pooled across groups) |
| `rw_cohort_walks` | S8 | RW with cell intercepts and one walk per adoption cohort |
| `etwfe_pooled`, `rw_pooled`, `rwi_pooled`, `rwst_pooled`, `xgb_pooled` | S8 | the cell models with adoption-cohort effects pooled across noncore and other counties (`options(etwfe.group = FALSE)`) |

`models: null` fits all of them (the S5 variants only with covariates). Existing files are skipped unless `-P overwrite:true`. Every replication has its own seed, `203 + 10000 (scenario − 1) + r`, so a refit reproduces a file exactly. Exception: the saved fits of `twfe`, `etwfe_pooled`, `twfe_v` and `etwfe_v` behind the reported results come from an earlier version of this notebook that did not seed each replication. A refit reproduces their point predictions (`y0_hat`, hence RMSE and bias) exactly, but their bootstrap draws (hence coverage, interval score and CRPS) only within Monte Carlo error.

```
quarto render analysis/02_fit_placebo.qmd
quarto render analysis/02_fit_placebo.qmd -P covariates:true
quarto render analysis/02_fit_placebo.qmd -P 'models:["twfe","etwfe"]'
```

Run time on 18 cores, per specification: TWFE, ETWFE and the variants minutes each; RW and RW-IID about 1 h; GB-Ens about 2 h; RW-ST about 5 h; the S8 models about as long again as their main counterparts.

```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(parallel)
invisible(lapply(list.files("R", "[.]r$", full.names = TRUE), source))
cfg <- params
cov <- isTRUE(cfg$covariates)
covariates <- if (cov) c("uemp", "pov", "mhinc", "aian") else NULL
original <- as.data.table(readRDS(panel_file()))
# Covariates standardized once over the panel; tc = (year - 2010) / 10 for the time-varying TWFE slopes.
panel <- if (cov) backdate_covariate_panel(original)[, tc := (year - 2010) / 10] else original[, .(i, year, start_year, urb, y, n)]
rm(original)
load("data/W")
rownames(W) <- NULL
options(xpn.conf = list(Lset = c(2, 4), graph = Matrix::Matrix(W)))
assignments <- readRDS("data/simulation/simulated_assignments_with_meta.rds")$assignments
Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1, MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1)
INLA::inla.setOption(num.threads = 1)
```

```{r models}
rhs <- if (cov) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else "1"
fe <- function(fm) list(impute = impute_fe, args = list(fm = as.formula(fm)))
nested <- function(...) list(impute = impute_inla, args = list(fit_fun = function(x)
  fit_nested(x, structural_only = TRUE, covariates = covariates, ...)))
gbens <- list(impute = impute_xgb, args = list(verbose = FALSE, predictors = covariates))
main <- list(
  twfe = fe(paste("y0 ~", rhs, "| i + year")),
  etwfe = fe(paste("y0 ~", rhs, "| cell + year")),
  rw = nested(iid = FALSE),
  rwi = nested(iid = TRUE),
  rwst = nested(iid = FALSE, spatial = TRUE),
  xgb = gbens)
variants <- if (cov) list(
  twfe_v = fe("y0 ~ uemp + pov + mhinc + aian + tc:(uemp + pov + mhinc + aian) | i + year"),
  etwfe_v = fe("y0 ~ 1 | cohort[uemp, pov, mhinc, aian] + year[uemp, pov, mhinc, aian]"))
s8 <- c(list(rw_cohort_walks = nested(iid = FALSE, walks = "cohort")),
  setNames(main[c("etwfe", "rw", "rwi", "rwst", "xgb")], paste0(c("etwfe", "rw", "rwi", "rwst", "xgb"), "_pooled")))
models <- c(main, variants, s8)
todo <- if (is.null(cfg$models)) names(models) else unlist(cfg$models)
stopifnot(all(todo %in% names(models)))
todo
```

```{r fits}
out <- file.path(cfg$out_root, if (cov) "wcov" else "wocov")
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
keep <- c("i", "year", if (cov) "tc", "start_year", "start_year_sim", "urb", "y", "n", "y0_hat",
  paste0("y0_post_", seq_len(cfg$nboot)))
for (model in todo) for (k in cfg$scenarios) {
  path <- file.path(out, sprintf("%s_%s.rds", model, k))
  if (file.exists(path) && !isTRUE(cfg$overwrite)) {cat("exists, skipped:", path, "\n"); next}
  m <- models[[model]]
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  res <- mclapply(seq_len(cfg$nrep), function(r) {
    # Pooled-cohort models: cohort_cell() returns the adoption cohort instead of the cohort x group cell.
    options(etwfe.group = !grepl("_pooled$", model))
    dt <- copy(panel)
    set_y0(dt, A_sim = assignments[, r, k])
    set.seed(203L + (k - 1L) * 10000L + r)
    do.call(fit_blind, c(list(dt = dt, .impute = m$impute, nboot = cfg$nboot), m$args))
    prov <- attr(dt, "xgb_provenance")
    merges <- if (is.null(prov)) paste(attr(dt, "cell_merges"), collapse = ";") else
      unlist(lapply(prov$cell_merges, paste, collapse = ";"))
    list(fit = dt[year < start_year, ..keep], prov = prov,
      merges = data.table(r = r, scenario = k, member = seq_along(merges), merged = merges))
  }, mc.cores = if (grepl("^rwst", model)) min(cfg$mc_cores, 16L) else cfg$mc_cores)
  failed <- vapply(res, inherits, NA, "try-error")
  if (any(failed)) stop(sum(failed), " replications failed: ", model, ", scenario ", k, "; first: ", res[[which(failed)[1]]])
  saveRDS(rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "fit"), idcol = "r"), path)
  # Cells with no untreated deaths merged into their cohort (cohort_cell()), per replication.
  merges <- rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "merges"))[nzchar(merged)]
  if (nrow(merges)) fwrite(merges, file.path(out, sprintf("cell_merges_%s_%s.csv", model, k)))
  # GB-Ens: features, gain per member, baseline, git commit and sessionInfo per replication.
  if (grepl("^xgb", model)) saveRDS(lapply(res, `[[`, "prov"), sub("\\.rds$", "_provenance.rds", path))
  rm(res); gc()
  cat(model, "scenario", k, ":", format(Sys.time() - t0), "; replications with merged cells:", uniqueN(merges$r), "\n")
}
```
